bug_semantics: awxkit's custom PyYAML Loader registers !include and !import and passes attacker-controlled scalar, sequence, or mapping values to extractFile(). Before the fix, extractFile() joined that value to the importing YAML file's directory, expanded it with glob.glob(), converted matches to absolute paths, and opened them without rejecting absolute paths, '..' traversal, or symlink escapes. A user who runs 'awx --conf.format yaml import' on a crafted YAML document can therefore cause the local client to read and parse arbitrary YAML-formatted files outside the document directory. The attack is local/client-side, requires the victim to import the malicious file, and compromises confidentiality.
flaw_origin: The vulnerable extractor first appears in ansible/awx's public Git history only in 9616cc6f7856523ebf6d1580443313296c9f6507 ('import awxkit'), an aggregate import of 101 files and 10,479 lines. Pull request #4451 is titled 'open source awxkit', and its discussion refers to the pre-existing code as towerkit and says awxkit will replace tower-cli. Thus 9616cc6f7856523ebf6d1580443313296c9f6507 is a public-history gateway/copy, not the smallest authoring commit that created the flawed path handling. The source authoring history is not present in the validated clone or exposed by the import PR, so the true BIC cannot be named without substituting an excluded aggregate import.
ai_marker: Unavailable for the true BIC: its commit object is outside the public ansible/awx history, so author/committer identity and AI trailers cannot be inspected under the BIC-only rule. The public gateway 9616cc6f7856523ebf6d1580443313296c9f6507 has human author Ryan Petrello and six human Co-authored-by trailers and no AI/Generated-with trailer, but that aggregate import is explicitly not used as the BIC or as AI evidence. CodeRabbit activity is confined to the 2026 fix and is likewise irrelevant to BIC attribution.
evidence: Advisory: https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-g29c-rgq6-gxgj identifies CVE-2026-52902/GHSA-g29c-rgq6-gxgj, awxkit <=24.6.1, no patched package version, and the crafted-YAML '!include' import path. In the validated clone, 'git log -L 52,85:awxkit/awxkit/yaml_file.py' and 'git log -S"def extractFile" -- awxkit/awxkit/yaml_file.py' both lead from the 2026 fix back to 9616cc6f7856523ebf6d1580443313296c9f6507. 'git show 9616cc6f7856523ebf6d1580443313296c9f6507:awxkit/awxkit/yaml_file.py' shows file_pattern=os.path.join(self._root, filename), glob.glob(file_pattern), os.path.abspath(file_path), and open(file_path) with no containment check. 'git show 9b836abf1fc36c703c26683fd7bf1343254bff91:awxkit/awxkit/yaml_file.py' fails because the file is absent from the aggregate import's direct parent. 'git show --stat 9616cc6f7856523ebf6d1580443313296c9f6507' reports 101 new files and 10,479 insertions; 'git log --reverse 9b836abf1fc36c703c26683fd7bf1343254bff91..adaa4148c69592e504a232a54cd6b767d32628d7' shows the import PR has only the aggregate import plus a CI/flake8 follow-up, not the original authoring commits. https://github.com/ansible/awx/pull/4451 is titled 'open source awxkit' and documents pre-existing towerkit provenance, establishing the genuine public-history boundary. 'git tag --contains 9616cc6f7856523ebf6d1580443313296c9f6507 --sort=version:refname' starts at 7.0.0 and continues through 24.6.1; 'git merge-base --is-ancestor 9616cc6f7856523ebf6d1580443313296c9f6507 24.6.1' succeeds. Fix 405c56e2bcaee1965a6f57520623cfa47612c9e2 (2026-08-20, PR #16608) canonicalizes the root, rejects stdin/absolute/traversing paths, validates normalized paths before globbing and real paths after globbing to stop symlink escapes, adds PathTraversalError, and adds regression coverage. The direct PR commits are 3fd379817bd16e499a4fd2eaf7a9a6133aa5dd7b followed by final head fab2e001bd480f9933382774ee0921aa45e62354; stable patch-id 2ead8782c701384afc3a3330e20a7378e6c20753 matches the cumulative PR-head diff and landing commit, reproducing direct_fix_sha. 'git tag --contains 405c56e2bcaee1965a6f57520623cfa47612c9e2' returns no tags and 'git merge-base --is-ancestor 405c56e2bcaee1965a6f57520623cfa47612c9e2 24.6.1' fails, so the source fix is landed on devel but no patched awxkit release/tag exists at audit time.
reasoning: The vulnerability and closing source change are reproducible, including the vulnerable release ceiling and the absence of a tagged patched package. Causal attribution is not: the first public commit is an explicit bulk open-source import of already-existing awxkit/towerkit code, and its parent merely proves absence from ansible/awx, not absence from the unpublished source history. Treating that gateway as the BIC would violate the protocol's prohibition on moves/imports and aggregates. Because AI judgment must use the true BIC commit object only, neither the human-looking 2019 import object nor CodeRabbit's later fix participation can support NOT_AI or an AI verdict. This is therefore BLOCKED at a genuine public-history boundary rather than EVIDENCE_GAP over an obtainable fact.
remaining_gap: The pre-2019 awxkit/towerkit authoring Git history, specifically the smallest commit that first wrote extractFile() without path containment and its immediate parent, is not public in the validated ansible/awx clone or PR #4451. Without that commit object, parent absence and BIC-only AI-marker checks cannot be completed; 9616cc6f7856523ebf6d1580443313296c9f6507 is only the excluded aggregate public import.
